The '''Grand Market at Jho-kang'ma''' was a marketplace on an unknown [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which existed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the pickpocket [[Zerba Cher'dak]] arrived on this market. He wanted to show himself as a magician so that he would be able to earn some money. Shortly after, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] appeared to hire Zerba whereas the same affiliated with Han.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
